meal.Description: A meal: breakfast, lunch, dinner, coffee or snacks, alone or with colleagues or customers.

rideshare.Description: Ground transport by taxi or rideshare, such as Uber or Lyft.

other.Description: Anything else: hotels, flights, equipment, software, conference fees, and so on.

Exclusions.WhenTrue: The description names alcohol (beer, wine, cocktails, a bar), a gift, or entertainment (tickets, shows, sporting events, golf).
Exclusions.WhenFalse: The description names none of these. A plain meal or ride counts as false.
